subject.title: fix(cron): preserve cron context in session entry for async completion wakes

question: Should PR #101078 land with the new durable cron SessionEntry marker, base-session wake routing, and trusted synthetic model override as the accepted cron async-media continuation contract?
rationale: The code path appears correct, but the fix changes compatibility-sensitive persisted session state and completion routing semantics that should be accepted by a maintainer before merge.

options.title: Accept the narrow session-routing fix
options.body: Merge after accepting the durable cron marker, base-session wake routing, and trusted synthetic override as the intended fix for #99919.

options.title: Require stronger upgrade proof
options.body: Ask for one more exact-head proof that non-cron sessions and existing rows without bootstrapContextRunKind behave unchanged.

options.title: Pause for owner-designed continuation contract
options.body: Pause this PR if maintainers do not want cron continuation state stored on SessionEntry and prefer a broader session-continuation API.

recommendation.title: Accept the narrow session-routing fix
recommendation.body: Merge after accepting the durable cron marker, base-session wake routing, and trusted synthetic override as the intended fix for #99919.

likelyOwner.reason: They authored the adjacent merged cron generated-media continuation fix that this PR builds on, making them the best available history owner for the routing choice.
